headline: Europe’s AI labeling and transparency rules are now in effect
summary: EU's new AI Act transparency rules are now active. Companies must disclose when users interact with AI models. The rules aim to identify chatbots and deepfakes.

headline: The first-gen Kindle Scribe is a big e-reader and digital notebook that’s $150 refurbished
summary: The Kindle Scribe is on sale for $149.99 refurbished. It features a large 10.2-inch screen for reading textbooks. It also functions as a digital notebook for handwritten notes.

headline: Microsoft is bringing Xbox 360 games to PC
summary: Microsoft plans to bring Xbox 360 games to PC, following original Xbox titles. A leaked document reveals developer plans for the initiative. Games will be playable on next-gen hardware.

headline: Bluesky’s new CEO wants a big tent, not a bubble
summary: Toni Schneider is the new CEO of social platform Bluesky. He aims for Bluesky to be an inclusive 'big tent' platform. This interview discusses his vision for the company.

headline: Spider-Man’s Record-Breaking Box Office Clinches It: Marvel as We Know It Is Over
summary: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" achieved record-breaking box office success. This success is predicted to negatively impact the MCU. The Marvel Cinematic Universe may be irrevocably changed.

headline: The Steam Frame Might End Up More Expensive Than the Steam Machine
summary: A deleted stream by a Valve leaker suggests the "Steam Frame" is coming. The device may exceed the Steam Machine in price. Details are scarce but speculation is growing.

headline: Shift Up CEO Defends Stellar Blade: Blood Rain AI Music Video Against Player Backlash
summary: Shift Up's CEO defended an AI-generated music video for "Blood Rain". The video was created to promote the "Stellar Blade" sequel. Players reacted negatively to the use of AI.

headline: Today’s Best Deals: Pokémon TCG Amazon Restocks, MTG x TMNT, Hisense 65” U6 Pro 4K TV, and More
summary: Amazon has restocked Pokémon TCG products. Deals include Magic: The Gathering x TMNT crossovers. Other sales feature a Hisense 65” U6 Pro 4K TV.

headline: Russia says seven killed and 40 injured by Ukrainian drone hitting busy beach
summary: A Ukrainian drone reportedly hit a busy beach in Russia. Seven people were killed, including three children. The incident also left 40 people injured.

headline: Infantino opponents threaten 'non co-operation' with Fifa
summary: Opponents of Fifa President Infantino threaten non-cooperation. The English FA plans to withdraw support for his re-election bid. Wales is also joining the movement against Infantino.

headline: Iran says it is in talks with Oman but not the US after Trump says negotiations to resume
summary: Iran confirms talks with Oman, but denies direct talks with the US. This follows Donald Trump's claim of resuming US-Iran negotiations. Trump strongly condemned Iran's leadership after their denial.

headline: France hits out at Reform UK plan to return migrants using Navy
summary: France criticizes Reform UK's proposal to use the Navy for migrant returns. Reform UK intends to override French objections to return migrants to France. The plan has sparked diplomatic tensions.
